description: Which personal details your school insists on recording. The list itself ships with the application — you decide which of them are required. A detail that a cohort matching rule reads must be required before that rule can be used, because a rule cannot match on something nobody has filled in.

fields.description: Tick to insist this is recorded. On an application form it is refused if left blank; on a person's record and on an import it is a warning, so that correcting an unrelated field is never blocked by a rule enabled after the record was made.
fields.label: Required

fields.description: Where this detail is stored on a person's record. Part of the application, not a setting.
fields.label: Field

fields.description: Whether a cohort matching rule can read this detail. Only a few can.
fields.label: Used by Matching Rules

fields.description: Worked out by the system rather than typed — a map position, for example. Required here means it must be resolvable, which the Cohort Planner reports before a run rather than a form refusing a save.
fields.label: Worked Out, Not Typed

name: Mandatory Personal Field
